title: Temporary Legal Secretary
description:
Temporary Legal Secretary (2 Week Assignment)

Jewellery Quarter, Birmingham

13.45 - 14.00 Per Hour

Immediate Start Required

BCR/JN/32587

Bell Cornwall Recruitment are looking for an experienced Temporary Legal Secretary to support the 2 solicitors in a high street law firm based in the Jewellery Quarter.

Secretarial support will mainly be required across Family, Criminal and Personal Injury matters.

A Temporary Legal Secretary will be required (But not limited) to:
- Answering incoming calls and taking accurate messages.
- Speaking to clients
- Arranging appointments and meetings
- Typing letters, emails and documents dictated by a solicitor.
- Formatting and reviewing documents
- Opening, updating and organising client files.
- Scanning, photocopying, saving and filing documents

A Temporary Legal Secretary will need experience in:
- Past experience supporting a Solicitor directly is essential
- Experience typing up documents, letters and emails
- Strong MS Office skills
- Comfortable answering phone calls and speaking with clients
- Knowledge of Case Management Systems

If you are Immediately Available, can commute to the Jewellery Quarter, and are experienced with supporting solicitors in day to day activities, don't hesitate to get in touch to find out more!
